**Windows 10/11 (x64).** Pick one:

- `Idolize Setup <version>.exe`: installs Idolize with a Start menu and desktop shortcut.
- `Idolize-<version>-portable.exe`: runs without installing.

The builds aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on the first start: choose *More info → Run
anyway*. You need your own TIDAL account with an active subscription.

macOS and Linux: coming soon.

Idolize is an independent project, not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by TIDAL.
